body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Toshiba(www.toshiba.com) introduced 64GB SDXC memory card at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
SDXC memory card of Toshiba is the fatest memory card until now and the maximum speed is 60MB/s for reading and 35MB/s for writing.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
